+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""RoboTwin 2.0 standard-mode controller for shake_bottle_horizontally.
+
+Run a single phase at a time (approach, descend, close, lift, shake) so the
+camera and measured gripper opening can be checked between contact-sensitive
+motions. End-effector positions below refer to the EE frame; the left TCP is
+0.12 m forward along world +y for the chosen wrist orientation.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/runs/shake_bottle_horizontally")
+Q_LEFT = np.array([0.7071068, 0.0, 0.0, 0.7071068], dtype=np.float32)
+# Bottle center estimated from head-camera pixels plus metric depth.
+CX, CY = -0.18, 0.005
+
+
+def save_obs(obs, name):
+    d = OUT / name
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    (d / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+    for cam, frame in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(d / f"{cam}.jpg", quality=92)
+    if obs.proprio is not None:
+        np.save(d / "proprio.npy", obs.proprio)
+
+
+def current(robot):
+    obs = robot.get_obs()
+    save_obs(obs, "latest")
+    return obs, np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def pose_action(now, left_xyz, left_gripper, left_q=None):
+    """Build one dual-arm EE pose row, retaining the right arm's measured pose."""
+    if left_q is None:
+        left_q = now[17:21]
+    left = np.r_[np.asarray(left_xyz, dtype=np.float32), left_q, np.float32(left_gripper)]
+    right = now[21:28].copy()
+    right[7 - 0] if False else None  # keep row construction explicit below
+    return np.r_[left, right].astype(np.float32)
+
+
+def run_phase(phase):
+    robot = Robot()
+    obs, now = current(robot)
+    print("time_left_s", obs.meta.get("time_left_s"), "phase", phase)
+    if phase == "approach":
+        # TCP target is above the bottle; subtract the 0.12 m EE-to-TCP offset.
+        target = pose_action(now, [CX, CY - 0.12, 0.96], 1.0, Q_LEFT)
+        result = robot.submit("ee_pose", target, video="both", note="left arm approach above bottle")
+    elif phase == "descend":
+        # Place the open jaws around the bottle body at tabletop height.
+        target = pose_action(now, [CX, CY - 0.12, 0.815], 1.0, Q_LEFT)
+        result = robot.submit("ee_pose", target, video="both", note="lower open left gripper around bottle")
+    elif phase == "close":
+        # Hold the current EE pose while closing; gripper is controlled in EE action slot 7.
+        target = pose_action(now, now[14:17], 0.0, now[17:21])
+        result = robot.submit("ee_pose", target, video="both", note="close left gripper on bottle")
+    elif phase == "lift":
+        target = pose_action(now, [CX, CY - 0.12, 1.055], 0.0, Q_LEFT)
+        result = robot.submit("ee_pose", target, video="both", note="lift bottle clear of table")
+    elif phase == "shake":
+        # Alternating 14 cm horizontal strokes at a raised, constant height.
+        # The repeated reversals create several horizontal shake cycles.
+        xs = [CX + x for x in (-0.07, 0.07, -0.07, 0.07, -0.07, 0.07, -0.07, 0.07)]
+        rows = [pose_action(now, [x, CY - 0.12, 1.055], 0.0, Q_LEFT) for x in xs]
+        result = robot.submit("ee_pose", np.stack(rows), video="both", note="shake held bottle horizontally")
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(phase)
+    print("result", json.dumps(result.meta, indent=2))
+    save_obs(result, phase)
+    if result.last:
+        p = result.proprio
+        if p is not None and len(p):
+            print("last proprio", np.round(p[-1], 4).tolist())
+        print("saved", OUT / phase)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("phase", choices=["approach", "descend", "close", "lift", "shake"])
+    run_phase(parser.parse_args().phase)
